newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Project Software cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Project Software cut.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co analyst Eric Upin cut his estimates today on Project Software and Development and lowered rating to long-term attractive.
-- PSDI forecasted preliminary second quarter results with numbers measurably below Street's expectations. Earnings per share seen at $0.15, 57 percent below estimates.
-- Upin cited weakness in the European market, increasing field of competitors, and some intra-company weaknesses. His EPS estimates for F1997 and F1998 are $0.98 and $1.26, respectively.
